Answer five (5) of items (a) - (h). Each item carries 4 marks. ​ ​ ​ ​ (a) “You will not die.” (Gen. 3:4). (i) Who was the speaker? (ii) To whom was it spoken? (iii) Where was it said? (iv) In which occasion? (b) “Go now, see if it is well with your brothers, and with the flock; and bring me word again” (Gen. 37:14). (i) Identify the speaker. (ii) To whom was the speech directed? (iii) Where were these brothers and what were they doing? (c) Mention the speaker of each of the following narrations. (i) “This book of the Lord shall not depart out of your mouth” (Joshua 1:8). (ii) “What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood” (Gen. 37:26). (iii) “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the Lord” (Ex. 32:5). (iv) “We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.” (Num.13-31). (d) “Up! For this is the day in which the Lord has given Sisera into your hand” (Judges 4:14). (i) Mention the speaker and his/her position. (ii) To whom were they addressed? (iii) Who was Sisera? (e) “For I will pass through the land of Egypt that night and I will smite the first born in the land of Egypt…” (Ex. 12:12). Who said these words and to whom? (f) “Let this thing be done for me; let me alone two months, that I may go and wonder on the mountains , and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.” (Judges 11:37). (i) Who was the speaker of these words? (ii) To whom were they spoken? (iii) Name the place where these words were spoken. (g) Mention four promises which were given by the Lord to Abraham during his call in Genesis 12:1-3. (h) How many were Jacob’s children? Mention his first born. Most of the people (in the Bible) showed unwillingness when they were called by God. What excuses did Moses give when he was called?

In Exodus 20, God gave the Israelites Ten Commandments. (a) List the commandments that are about the relationship of the people to God. (b) Write down the commandments which are about the relationship among the people of Israel themselves.
Mention the ten plagues sent by God to the Egyptians during the struggle of Israelites’ liberation.
Describe how Moses was called by God to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
Gideon was called by God to be a Judge over Israel. How did God assure Gideon that He was with him?

“I will make my covenant between me and you and will multiply you exceedingly.” (Gen.17:21). (a) Who are the two parties of the pact?
